callback reads endBlock to decide whether the round must be closed
endLottery iterates over the users array to determine the winner

normalization_plan.reason: The winner parameter only exists to feed the external transfer, so it is absorbed by the unsafe transfer operation
winticket is a local helper value stored inside withrawWin and has no independent role beyond that function
The index parameter is used solely for the array lookup performed by getPlayerAddress
The index parameter is used solely for the array lookup performed by getPlayerBet
The condition parameter is the single guard expression of the onlyIf modifier and can be folded into it
sum is a transient accumulator fully contained in endLottery's settlement loop
winningNumber is a transient derived value fully contained in endLottery
i is the loop counter of endLottery and carries no state beyond the iteration
tempTot is a temporary snapshot of totalBets used only inside withrawWin
